payload.title: validation._pinned_worktree runs git worktree add, remove and prune without the kernel's hooks-off arguments on the commit under proof, so where the repository config sets core.hooksPath=.husky the agent tip's own .husky/post-checkout runs as the executor, outside the sandbox, on the PR-open authority path
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:755-780 (git worktree add, remove and prune through plain git, no hooks-off arguments, on the agent's tip)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:503-504 (prove_red_first checks each side out through it)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:1059-1062 (the apply gate's finding-origin proof reaches it)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_delivery.py:179-185 (the delivery's contract: every executor git subprocess touching the agent's tree runs hooks off, because a runner core.hooksPath would run the agent's .husky hook)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:989-992 (the lift in the same slice does pass the hooks-off arguments)
payload.rule_violated: implementation_delivery module contract (lines 179-185): every executor git subprocess that touches a tree the agent wrote runs with hooks off; CLAUDE.md Security, untrusted code does not run outside the sandbox.
payload.notes: Reproduced by the verifier in a scratch repository: with core.hooksPath=.husky and a commit that adds an executable .husky/post-checkout, git worktree add --detach <dir> <that commit> ran the hook and wrote a marker file. In the gate the green side is the agent's branch tip, so an agent that commits such a hook gets code execution as the executor uid during the red-first proof, outside bwrap, whenever the runner's repository config carries a hooksPath (the delivery docstring names npm run hooks:install and npm ci without --ignore-scripts as ways it gets set). Not shown here: that the production runner checkout sets core.hooksPath. Implementation authority is off today, so no break is proven reachable. Close condition: Run every git call of _pinned_worktree with KERNEL_GIT_NO_HOOKS_ARGS and a scrubbed environment, preferably through one hardened worktree runner shared with request_worktree.run_worktree_git; a test commits a .husky/post-checkout under a repository with core.hooksPath=.husky and asserts prove_red_first does not run it. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
